description: This file defines data schemas for a deep research agent, including classes for tasks, subtasks, research plans, results, and related structures, primarily using Pydantic models.

classes.name: Subtask
classes.description: Represents a single subtask in the research plan with attributes like task ID, description, dependencies, depth, and parallelization capability.

classes.name: SubtaskList
classes.description: Wrapper class for a list of Subtask objects, used for schema validation.

classes.name: TaskDescriptions
classes.description: Schema for a list of task description strings.

classes.name: TaskDependencies
classes.description: Represents dependency mapping for a single task, including task ID and list of dependencies.

classes.name: TaskDependenciesList
classes.description: Wrapper class for a list of TaskDependencies objects.

classes.name: ResearchPlan
classes.description: Encapsulates a complete research plan with a question, list of subtasks, max depth, total tasks, and parallel groups.

classes.name: TaskResult
classes.description: Stores the result of executing a research task, including findings, sources, and confidence.

classes.name: ResearchReport
classes.description: Final report synthesizing research question, summary, detailed findings, conclusions, and overall confidence.

classes.name: SearchQueries
classes.description: Schema for a list of search query strings.

classes.name: Citation
classes.description: Represents a source citation with URL, title, and excerpt.

classes.name: ResearchFindings
classes.description: Structured research findings with numbered points, citations, and confidence level.

classes.name: TaskMerge
classes.description: Instruction for merging duplicate or related tasks, specifying which to keep and which to merge.

classes.name: TaskMergeList
classes.description: List of TaskMerge instructions for deduplication.

classes.name: SearchStrategy
classes.description: Defines the search strategy for a parent task, including strategy type and reasoning.

methods.name: BaseModel
methods.description: Base class from Pydantic for data validation and serialization.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Function from Pydantic to define model fields with metadata.
